title: Obama Questions 'Carried Interest' Tax Break
主要内容: President Barack Obama questioned the 'carried interest' tax break, a provision benefiting private equity and hedge fund managers. He emphasized the need for additional tax revenue to reduce the U.S. deficit and signaled intent to eliminate such loopholes. This aligns with his re-election campaign promise to raise rates for the wealthiest Americans. In early 2013, Obama pushed through a legislative package increasing tax rates for high-income individuals and households. Obama criticized the carried interest tax break as unfair, calling for it to be taxed as ordinary income. The tax break was a key factor in the low tax rate paid by Mitt Romney, his 2012 Republican presidential challenger. In the year-end budget deal, capital gains and dividend taxes for incomes above $400,000 per individual or $450,000 per family were increased to 20 percent from 15 percent. The budget law extended ordinary tax cuts for incomes below $400,000 per individual or $450,000 per family, with income above that level taxed at 39.6%.
